clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind Keep, Bishop DeLavey hears the court's quiet concerns. He represents the Church of the Holy Light in the Petitioner's Chamber, where matters of faith and state meet.

Bishop DeLavey advises Stormwind's court from within the keep. While Archbishop Benedictus tends to the Cathedral of Light, DeLavey lives among the nobility and petitioners. He brings spiritual counsel to the court while reckoning with the kingdom's politics. His place there lets him hear whispered rumors and delicate grievances before they reach Highlord Bolvar Fordragon or the young King Anduin.
